---
name: Documentation problem
about: Report incorrect, unclear or missing documentation.
---

# Documentation problem

This issue will be public. Use [private security reporting](https://github.com/lloydsmart/wii-netdisc/security/advisories/new)
for vulnerabilities and the [code of conduct](https://github.com/lloydsmart/wii-netdisc/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#reporting-concerns)
for private conduct reports. Do not attach credentials, private information,
disc images, console dumps or the raw historical archive.

## Location

Link the affected file and section. Include the commit or branch you read,
if known.

## Problem

What is incorrect, unclear or missing? Describe what you expected to understand.
For a broken link, include the page containing it and the intended destination,
if known.

## Suggested correction

If you have a proposed improvement, describe it here. Include supporting sources
for factual corrections, and identify any uncertainty or unverified historical
claim.
